name: 书剑3
english_description: Extracted from a nested archive that also bundled an Android client APK alongside this source tree, which uses it: connecting players get a one-shot handshake banner and then submit account/password/nickname/gender fields via a custom delimiter-based mobile protocol rather than the usual line-by-line prompts. Despite the shared "Book and Sword" branding, it shares no code lineage with bxsj/bxsj1 or any other library in this collection — an entirely independent codebase, richer than a simple sect-and-map layout thanks to instanced dungeon content (`d/fuben/`) plus dedicated music and guild areas. A full playthrough confirmed apprenticeship into the Wudang sect, sect-map travel, combat, death, and a Ghost Gate revival cycle all work end to end.
